observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with black backdrop and wooden railing, audience visible in foreground; performance/talent show occasion
observation.formation_and_space: line formation across the stage, moving into clusters and shifting positions
observation.posture: torso slightly leaning forward with bent knees, weight shifting across feet
observation.footwork: step-touches, low hopping steps, and rapid alternating foot lifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms moving fluidly, bent at elbows, often holding or adjusting wrapped skirts
observation.hips_and_torso: energetic hip shimmies and torso shakes synchronized with fast footwork
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level squats, lunges, floor-bound sitting stretches, and spins
observation.costume_and_props: matching black long-sleeved tops with cutouts, patterned skirts/wraps in blue and green
observation.cannot_infer: fast footwork and weight transfer details are obscured by low video resolution and stage lighting

signature_moments.what: dancers step in a line while shaking hips and swinging arms side to side
dancers drop down into side lunges with one leg extended
dancers sit on the floor in a split position, shaking shoulders and torso
